First, the bartender is adding more alcohol than usual. On one hand, being generous might mean they're trying to be kind or make the experience better. Maybe they think I'll enjoy a stronger drink. It might make me more intoxicated than I intended, which could lead to negative consequences like impaired judgment or health issues.

So, considering all these points, even though the intention might be generous, the action itself isn't morally acceptable because it disregards my consent and could lead to harmful outcomes.
